title: Creeping Dark
effect: Remove a power token from Spreading Shadow. Repeat this. Then, Creeping Dark gains one nemesis token.
setup: Place Spreading Shadow into play. Place 7/8/9/11 power tokens on Spreading Shadow for 1/2/3/4 players. Creeping Dark gains one nemesis token.
rules: During any player's main phase, that player may spend 5 Æ to remove a nemesis token from Creeping Dark.

title: Jeweled Wrath
effect: Any player suffers 2 damage, gains two Cursed Shards from the Curse deck, and places them on top of their deck.
setup: Include six Cursed Shards in the Curse deck.

title: The Anomaly
effect: Reveal the top two cards of the nemesis deck. Put a minion or power revealed this way into play. Return the rest in any order. If no minion or power was revealed, Foe gains 4 charges.

title: The Corrosion
effect: Remove 2 power tokens from each power in play. Gravehold suffers 5 damage.
setup: Place the Draining Sign cards above this mat.

title: The Cultist
effect: Volatile Pylon gains 2 life. Then, remove a power token from Ritual of Flame three times.
rules: Place Volatile Pylon and Ritual of Flame into play.

title: The Hunger
effect:
Destroy a card from the supply pile with the fewest cards. Repeat this twice.
Then, draw a tendril.
setup:
Shuffle the tendril cards facedown to form the tendril deck. Set it above this mat.

Destroy two cards from each gem supply pile.
rules:
When a tendril is discarded from play, place it on the bottom of the tendril deck.

While there are two or less empty supply piles, The Hunger is dormant.

title: The Mask
effect:
Any player loses a nemesis token and deals 4 damage to the nemesis. Draw and resolve the top card of the nemesis deck.
OR
Any player gains a nemesis token. Repeat this.
setup: If you are playing with 1/2/3/4 players, 0/0/1/2 players gain a nemesis token and an Æ token.
rules: Whenever a player would gain a second nemesis token (third in true solo), they suffer 10 damage instead.

title: The Scavenger
effect: The player with the lowest life suffers 4 damage.

title: The Storm
effect: The player with the most prepped spells gains a Shock, places it into their hand, and suffers 1 damage for each of their prepped spells.
setup: Place the Shock cards above this mat to form the Shock supply pile.

title: The Swarm
effect: Place the bottommost minion from the nemesis discard pile back into play. If there are no minions in the nemesis discard pile, place two Broodlings into play instead.
setup: Place the Broodling cards above this mat.

title: The Traitor
effect: If the turn order discard pile contains a nemesis turn order card, shuffle it into the turn order deck. Otherwise, Unleash three times.
rules: If the nemesis would draw a card and can't, the players lose the game.
